name: InstantMesh (Fast Image → 3D)
description: TencentARC's fast multi-view reconstruction model (2024). Generates a 3D mesh from a single image in seconds by synthesising 6 multi-view images then running sparse-view LRM reconstruction.
author: TencentARC (extension by Dodai)

params_schema.label: Multi-view count
params_schema.tooltip: Number of synthetic views to generate before 3D reconstruction.

params_schema.label: Guidance scale
params_schema.tooltip: How closely the multi-view images follow the input.

params_schema.label: Export texture map
params_schema.tooltip: Bake a UV texture map onto the output mesh.
